svg.title: From Corridor Signal to Assignable Site Interest
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-evidence-backed-option-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: From Corridor Signal to Assignable Site Interest; subtitle: Sell documented development progress, not apparent electrical proximity.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Sequence numbers indicate work order rather than capacity or conversion probability. Typical first-deal timing is 2–6 months; utility studies can extend it. Maintain separate standalone BESS and AI campus underwriting templates.; caption: An attractive map intersection becomes a priced option only after power, land rights, upgrade exposure, and timing have survived documented diligence.; stages: label: Screen distinct site classes; value: Separate storage parcels from AI campus candidates; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Use QGIS, utility GIS, FEMA maps, and USFWS wetland mapping to screen 69kV–345kV corridors. Track 5–25 acre standalone BESS parcels separately from campuses requiring fiber, water, larger footprints, and load service.; label: Obtain utility evidence; value: Request dated capacity and service-path documentation; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Record requested load, injection and charging profiles, study status, contingencies, deliverable MW, upgrade allocation, and energization range. A substation pin or raw queue filing establishes neither available headroom nor a service commitment.; label: Secure contingent site control; value: Negotiate transferable 12–24 month option rights; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Have counsel verify ownership, title exceptions, mineral rights, easements, assignment permission, extension pricing, and utility or zoning exit rights. Document any recorded memorandum and distinguish nonrefundable fees from refundable escrow deposits.; label: Price documented development risk; value: Underwrite deliverable MW against remaining exposure; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Illustratively, 20 utility-documented MW at a negotiated $5,000 per-MW milestone yields $100,000 before direct costs. Price restudy exposure, energization delay, expiration losses, and buyer conditions separately; unvalidated MW supports no capacity-based value.; label: Assign and reconcile receipts; value: Close eligible transfers with an evidence ledger; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Deliver the executed option chain, dated study package, land-use findings, and contractual milestone evidence. Recognize earned assignment fees, origination payments, and realized carry without counting land price, developer capex, deposits, or unrealized carry.

circle.title: label: Screen distinct site classes; value: Separate storage parcels from AI campus candidates; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Use QGIS, utility GIS, FEMA maps, and USFWS wetland mapping to screen 69kV–345kV corridors. Track 5–25 acre standalone BESS parcels separately from campuses requiring fiber, water, larger footprints, and load service.

circle.title: label: Obtain utility evidence; value: Request dated capacity and service-path documentation; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Record requested load, injection and charging profiles, study status, contingencies, deliverable MW, upgrade allocation, and energization range. A substation pin or raw queue filing establishes neither available headroom nor a service commitment.

text.title: Record requested load, injection and charging profiles, study status, contingencies, deliverable MW, upgrade allocation, and energization range. A substation pin or raw queue filing establishes neither available headroom nor a service commitment.

circle.title: label: Secure contingent site control; value: Negotiate transferable 12–24 month option rights; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Have counsel verify ownership, title exceptions, mineral rights, easements, assignment permission, extension pricing, and utility or zoning exit rights. Document any recorded memorandum and distinguish nonrefundable fees from refundable escrow deposits.

text.title: Have counsel verify ownership, title exceptions, mineral rights, easements, assignment permission, extension pricing, and utility or zoning exit rights. Document any recorded memorandum and distinguish nonrefundable fees from refundable escrow deposits.

circle.title: label: Price documented development risk; value: Underwrite deliverable MW against remaining exposure; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Illustratively, 20 utility-documented MW at a negotiated $5,000 per-MW milestone yields $100,000 before direct costs. Price restudy exposure, energization delay, expiration losses, and buyer conditions separately; unvalidated MW supports no capacity-based value.

circle.title: label: Assign and reconcile receipts; value: Close eligible transfers with an evidence ledger; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Deliver the executed option chain, dated study package, land-use findings, and contractual milestone evidence. Recognize earned assignment fees, origination payments, and realized carry without counting land price, developer capex, deposits, or unrealized carry.

text.title: Deliver the executed option chain, dated study package, land-use findings, and contractual milestone evidence. Recognize earned assignment fees, origination payments, and realized carry without counting land price, developer capex, deposits, or unrealized carry.

Assumptions: Sequence numbers indicate work order rather than capacity or conversion probability. Typical first-deal timing is 2–6 months; utility studies can extend it. Maintain separate standalone BESS and AI campus underwriting templates.
